d: Two marathon runners, two tragic deaths, and a chilling reminder that fitness does not always mean freedom from health risks. In this video, Firstpost examines the deaths of 24-year-old Rachel Apa during the New York City Marathon and 36-year-old Kommineni Gopi after completing a marathon in Hyderabad. What causes seemingly fit runners to collapse suddenly? From hidden heart conditions and dangerous arrhythmias to electrolyte imbalances and rhabdomyolysis, we break down the medical risks of extreme endurance exercise.
